$comment: Library catalog (R-LIB-6). The single source of what Jjodel shares, until an administration service replaces this file with the same schema. kind: sealedNotation (case 1, a complete language used through the model editor only) or galleryProject (case 2, a project the user clones and owns). status: planned (decided, not built), available (built, its package under frontend/public), deferred (decided for later). publisher is always jjodel until R-LIB-3 opens the gallery to others. description (optional): the one line the Templates page shows under a galleryProject.

entries.label: State machine (UML statechart)
entries.notes: Composite states and orthogonal regions through graphVertex (R-GV); simulation profile stateMachine; codegen example turnstile.

entries.label: Petri net
entries.notes: Simulation profile petri; codegen example petri-producer-consumer.

entries.label: Activity (UML)
entries.notes: Same simulation profile as Flowchart, with decision/merge diamonds (R-VP-26).

entries.label: BPMN
entries.notes: Faithful to the OMG metamodel: pools, lanes via non-containment flowNodeRefs, events, gateways (R-GV benchmark).

entries.label: ER (Chen)
entries.notes: Four ER roles, as the derived notation of R-VP-23.

entries.label: UML class diagram
entries.notes: No derived notation exists today: drawn from scratch on the IR.

entries.label: Goal model (i*)
entries.notes: i* (iStar), as in OpenOME: actors with boundaries; goal, softgoal, task and resource; dependencies between actors; contribution links (help, hurt, make, break), AND decomposition and means-ends.

entries.label: Library
entries.description: Libraries, books, writers and members: containment, inheritance and cross references.
entries.notes: The fixture Library.ecore extended with writers (Library.writers, Book.authors), and a sample model.

entries.label: Families and Persons
entries.description: The Families2Persons pair: two metamodels and a model of each, ready for a transformation.
entries.notes: The classic Families2Persons pair; a JjTL transformation between them fits the gallery.

entries.label: StateMachine
entries.description: The Heater state machine: an enum, nested states and one deliberate validation error.
entries.notes: The Heater model, with its deliberate Broken state (no kind).

entries.label: Graph
entries.description: Nodes and edges, with single and multi-valued references.

entries.label: Shapes
entries.description: An abstract Shape and its concrete subclasses, instantiated by type.
